answer: Audits are recorded in dune, queued in harbor, and wharf publishes the wait time. A farm of 316 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 22 identities per epoch. A farm of 2176 identities would post 4475 proofs and burn roughly 11 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
